## Whitespace contradicts operator precedence Whitespace around nested operators contradicts precedence. --- The best fix is to make operator grouping visually explicit by adding whitespace (and optionally parentheses) around nested operators in the flagged condition, without changing logic.

In workers/steward/src/bounded-recheck-github.ts, update line 95’s catch statement so the conditional reads clearly:

  • from error instanceof Error&&error.message==='GITHUB_HTTP_404'
  • to error instanceof Error && error.message === 'GITHUB_HTTP_404'

This preserves existing functionality exactly and resolves the whitespace/precedence contradiction warning. No imports, new methods, or new definitions are required.

## Whitespace contradicts operator precedence Whitespace around nested operators contradicts precedence. --- To fix this class of issue, rewrite mixed-operator expressions so grouping is explicit and readable—typically by adding parentheses around each logical subcondition and adding consistent whitespace around operators.

For this specific case in workers/steward/src/bounded-recheck.ts, update line 123’s condition from:

  • 'retryAfter' in outcome&&outcome.retryAfter!==undefined

to:

  • ('retryAfter' in outcome) && outcome.retryAfter !== undefined

This preserves behavior exactly while removing ambiguity that triggered CodeQL. No imports, new methods, or definitions are required.

## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused function requireEmptyBody. ---

To fix this without changing functionality, remove the unused private helper requireEmptyBody from workers/steward/src/pr-body-api.ts.

  • **General approach:** delete unused non-exported code when it has no call sites.
  • **Best specific fix here:** remove lines 37–41 (the full requireEmptyBody function).
  • **Why this is best:** it resolves the CodeQL finding directly, avoids introducing artificial/meaningless usages, and does not alter runtime behavior because the function is currently not invoked.
  • **File/region:** workers/steward/src/pr-body-api.ts, the function block between delay and readJsonObject.
  • **No imports, methods, or definitions** are required.
